baseline_models.focus_anchor: خَسَفَ (خ س ف) governs ٱلْقَمَرُ (ق م ر).
baseline_models.mechanism: The ground-sinking branch of خ س ف applied to the moon-and-light branch makes the luminous disc behave like something swallowed beneath the field of visibility, not merely something whose color changes.

activation_trace.role: Ground sinking supplies a downward disappearance and gives the eclipse a spatial mechanism.
The heavenly moon together with its light supplies the luminous object that becomes unavailable.

changed_reading.before: The moon is eclipsed or darkened.
changed_reading.after: The moon and its light sink out of the visible order as though swallowed downward.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The verb خَسَفَ carries an eye-sinking branch, while ٱلْقَمَرُ names a bright disc whose root field also includes sight bewildered by whiteness.
baseline_models.mechanism: The moon can be imaged as a celestial eye: its bright disc or pupil goes inward and is put out, so the event is simultaneously failure of a luminous object and failure of seeing.

activation_trace.role: A sunken or put-out eye supplies the organ-failure image assigned to the lunar disc.
Sight bewildered by intense whiteness keeps the qamar field tied to optical overload and lost vision.

changed_reading.after: A celestial eye sinks and is put out, collapsing illumination and perception together.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: خَسَفَ can carry deprivation and bodily deficiency, and ٱلْقَمَرُ includes the moon with its light.
baseline_models.mechanism: Instead of relocating the moon, the verb can strip it of its usable yield. Light is treated as a provision or capacity withheld from the luminary.

activation_trace.role: Hunger, emaciation, and deficiency supply privation rather than spatial descent.
Moonlight supplies the operative yield removed by the privative action.

changed_reading.after: The moon is made deficient: its light-yield is withheld while the named body remains.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The imposed-abasement branch of خ س ف acts on the elevated luminary ٱلْقَمَرُ.
baseline_models.mechanism: A body conventionally high and conspicuous is made to bear humiliation. The eclipse becomes a status reversal as well as an optical event.

activation_trace.role: Abasement imposed on a person supplies forced lowering as the action's social force.
The bright moon in the sky supplies the conspicuous high body subjected to lowering.

changed_reading.after: The high luminary is forcibly abased, staging the collapse of visible rank.

context_deltas.mechanism: The named Day of rising places the moon's sinking on the opposite vertical axis: the interval in which creatures stand is also the interval in which a normally elevated regulator goes down.

activation_trace.role: Ground sinking supplies the downward pole of the reversal.
The moon in the sky supplies the normally elevated term that is brought low.
The severe event-day supplies a bounded catastrophic interval for the lunar reversal.
Resurrection and the standing of the Hour identify the upward event opposed by lunar sinking.
Bodily uprightness makes the standing-versus-sinking geometry explicit.

structural_cues: 75:1 and 75:6 repeat the Day-of-Rising expression before 75:8, enclosing the focus within that named interval.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a repeated rising-day frame and a downward-sinking focus verb; I infer a deliberate vertical inversion, while the live alternative is that the rising root only names the event and contributes no spatial contrast.

changed_reading.before: The moon undergoes an isolated eclipse during the final event.
changed_reading.after: On the Day of standing-up, the moon sinks down, making the focus a concise inversion of stable vertical order.

context_deltas.mechanism: The immediately preceding eye flashes, stares, or freezes; then the lunar disc undergoes an eye-like sinking. Human sight and the nocturnal object of sight fail as a coupled perceptual circuit.

activation_trace.role: The put-out or inward-sunken eye lets the focus verb describe optical organ failure.
Bewildered sight under intense whiteness connects the qamar field to failed visual processing.
The eye's flashing or fixed stare supplies the observer-side seizure immediately before the moon's failure.
Literal eyesight identifies the human visual faculty affected in the paired sequence.

structural_cues: 75:7-8 are adjacent coordinated clauses that move from the human eye to a bright celestial disc.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies an arrested eye followed by a verb branch for a put-out eye applied to the moon; I infer a mirror between observer and observed, while the alternative is a simple list of independent portents.

changed_reading.before: The visual metaphor in the focus is optional and confined to the moon.
changed_reading.after: The human eye is seized while the celestial eye sinks, so perceiver and luminous object collapse together.

context_deltas.mechanism: Repeated acts of gathering bones, the two luminaries, and recited material keep the moon's sinking from reading as bare annihilation. The focus becomes deactivation of a distinct luminous unit before collection into a new configuration, within a wider collect-and-manifest pattern.

activation_trace.role: Sinking supplies the temporary loss of the moon from its prior visible position.
The moon and its light supply the distinct celestial unit whose independent function ends.
Gathering separated bones supplies an earlier bodily instance of recomposition.
Joining what was separate supplies the immediate next operation performed on the luminaries.
The sun supplies the other luminous body joined to the deactivated moon.
The repeated moon confirms that the focus object persists into the collection clause.
Gathering recited material extends the same operation from body and cosmos into discourse.
Manifest appearance after collection supplies the process endpoint that contrasts with the moon's concealment.

structural_cues: The focus is followed immediately by the same moon as an object of collection in 75:9.
ج م ع recurs at 75:3, 75:9, and 75:17 across body, cosmos, and recitation, followed by disclosure at 75:19.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the moon's disappearance, its immediate reappearance in a collection, and repeated cross-domain gathering; I infer deactivation before recomposition, while the alternative is that these are independent uses and the moon's loss remains terminal within the celestial scene.

changed_reading.before: The moon sinks and is simply gone.
changed_reading.after: The moon loses its separate luminous operation and then persists as a gathered component in a controlled recomposition.

context_deltas.mechanism: The qamar field includes movement and hunting by moonlight. When that light sinks, nocturnal orientation closes; the following search for flight and refuge is funneled toward a single settlement rather than open space.

activation_trace.role: Approaching or hunting by moonlight supplies a practical orientation function for lunar visibility.
Sinking removes the orienting light from the available field.
Flight and escape supply the movement whose route is being sought.
Refuge supplies the protective destination explicitly denied after the lunar failure.
Fixed settlement supplies the unavoidable endpoint replacing free flight.

structural_cues: 75:8-12 proceeds from lost lunar visibility to the escape question, denial of refuge, and declaration of settlement.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies moonlight as a medium for nocturnal seeking and then flight, no refuge, and settlement; I infer that loss of lunar orientation helps close the escape-space, while the alternative is that panic follows the eclipse without the eclipse functionally blocking movement.

changed_reading.before: The moon darkens while the human separately becomes afraid.
changed_reading.after: The darkened moon participates in removing external orientation and narrowing every attempted flight toward one fixed destination.

context_deltas.mechanism: The focus removes an external light and images a put-out eye, but the later self remains an inward بصيرة. Visibility can collapse outside without removing the subject's evidence against itself.

activation_trace.role: Moonlight supplies the external illumination that is withdrawn.
The put-out eye supplies the collapse of outward seeing.
The thing itself or self supplies the interior bearer of unavoidable evidence.
Insight of the heart supplies a mode of seeing that does not depend on lunar light.

structural_cues: The ب ص ر field first names seized eyesight at 75:7 and later names the self's بصيرة at 75:14.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies extinguished external visibility and persistent inward insight; I infer a shift from environmental light to self-witness, while the alternative is that the two kinds of seeing are unrelated forensic and cosmic statements.

changed_reading.before: The focus announces a general loss of visibility.
changed_reading.after: External illumination and eyesight can fail, yet inward self-evidence remains lit and inescapable.

context_deltas.mechanism: After common lunar radiance is withdrawn, human faces divide into radiant, looking faces and grim, arrested faces. Light and visibility cease to be neutral environmental goods and become differentiated personal states.

activation_trace.role: The moon and its light supply the common celestial radiance that disappears.
The sunken-eye image supplies the loss of undifferentiated outward visibility.
The face supplies the human surface onto which visible state is reassigned.
Beauty and radiance supply positive luminosity now borne by particular faces.
Directed sight supplies restored, purposeful looking for the radiant group.
The scowling face supplies the opposed visible state of constriction and dread.

structural_cues: 75:22-24 balances two face clauses and places radiance and looking against grimness after the lunar light has failed.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies lost moonlight followed by opposed visible states on faces; I infer a redistribution of luminosity from cosmos to persons, while the alternative is that the face descriptions do not answer the earlier eclipse at all.

changed_reading.before: The lunar eclipse leaves a uniformly dark environment.
changed_reading.after: Common cosmic light is withdrawn, while radiance and sight reappear as differentiated conditions carried by human faces.

context_deltas.mechanism: The moon's eye-like shutdown and the joining of sun with moon can mirror the dying body's paired legs wrapping together before it is driven onward. The celestial scene reads as the terminal seizure of a macro-body.

activation_trace.role: A put-out eye supplies the first failing organ of the proposed cosmic body.
The bright celestial disc supplies the macro-body's eye-like organ.
Joining separate luminaries supplies the first paired-body contraction.
Wrapping one thing upon another supplies the bodily analogue for celestial convergence.
The paired legs supply the explicit bodily double corresponding to the paired luminaries.
Driving supplies the terminal movement that follows bodily and celestial seizure.

structural_cues: 75:9 pairs sun and moon; 75:29 repeats leg with leg, and 75:30 names the ensuing driving.
Both sequences move from loss of normal function into forced conjunction.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies an eye-sinking branch, paired luminaries, paired legs, and final driving; I infer a macrocosm-body analogy, while the materially live alternative is that the sky signs and deathbed physiology are parallel only in sequence, not in identity.

changed_reading.before: The focus is one astronomical sign among several.
changed_reading.after: The moon is the eye-like organ of a cosmic body entering terminal shutdown before its paired members are forced together and driven onward.

context_deltas.mechanism: The closing assertion of capacity over enlivening the dead relativizes apparent final loss. Lunar light can be read as an operative power withdrawn into a death-like state rather than an entity erased beyond restoration.

activation_trace.role: Deficiency and deprivation supply loss of function without requiring nonexistence.
Moonlight supplies the operative capacity placed into suspension.
Effective capacity supplies agency able to reverse a state that appears final.
Earth revived through rain and growth supplies a concrete pattern of restored operation after dormancy.
Departure of power and life supplies the terminal-looking state explicitly placed under that capacity.

structural_cues: 75:37-40 moves from a minute fluid origin through formation to the explicit opposition of enlivening and death.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies deprived lunar function and a closing claim of power to restore life; I infer that the eclipse models reversible deactivation, while the alternative is that resurrection applies only to humans and does not qualify the moon's fate.

changed_reading.before: The moon's sinking is terminal destruction.
changed_reading.after: The moon undergoes a cosmic death-like loss of power whose apparent finality is subordinated to capacity over restoration.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because the focus noun plainly denotes the heavenly moon, not gambling; it remains anchored because the packet preserves the qamar branch of contesting and defeat together with the focus verb's imposed abasement. Downstream prose should present it only as a lexical resonance of losing a wager or rank, never as the verse's direct lexical translation.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: ٱلْقَمَرُ carries a gambling-and-defeat branch, while خَسَفَ carries forced abasement.

activation_trace.role: Gambling, contesting, and defeat by trickery supply the image of a conspicuous player losing its stake.
Imposed abasement supplies the defeated party's loss of status.

changed_reading.before: An exalted celestial object is eclipsed.
changed_reading.after: At a contained branch-resonance level, the high luminary loses the cosmic contest and is stripped of stake and status.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is a branch-distant pastoral image rather than an alternate sense of the focus sentence. It remains anchored in the qamar inventory's untended night-property branch and in the later explicit act of leaving; prose should qualify it as an associative counterimage to ungoverned existence, not claim that the moon is literally abandoned or outside control.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: ٱلْقَمَرُ has a branch for property left untended at night, and its خَسَفَ marks the collapse of that apparently stable night order.

activation_trace.role: Property left without a keeper at night supplies the pastoral image of apparent neglect within the focus noun's branch field.
Sinking supplies the failure of an order that had seemed self-maintaining.
Releasing or leaving something supplies the explicit human question about being let go without oversight.

changed_reading.before: The moon's ordinary light simply fails.
changed_reading.after: The failed moon briefly resembles night-property without a keeper, a counterimage that sharpens the later denial that the human will be released ungoverned.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This activation is surprising because it uses the qamar branch for cold-struck dates that lose sweetness before ripening. It remains anchored in the focus noun and the deprivation branch of its verb, while the later preference for the immediate supplies a visible contextual hook. Prose should label it a material analogy about premature yield, not a lexical gloss for moon or eclipse.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The qamar field includes fruit blighted before ripening, while خَسَفَ includes deprivation and deficiency.

activation_trace.role: Cold-struck dates losing sweetness before maturity supply the image of a prematurely ruined yield.
Deprivation and bodily deficiency supply the loss of the yield's sustaining value.
Haste and bringing forward supply the contextual preference for what arrives before completion.
Love fixed in the heart supplies attachment to that prematurely taken yield.

changed_reading.before: The moon loses brightness at the end-time.
changed_reading.after: As a contained material echo, the moon is a yield blighted before ripening, mirroring attachment to the immediate before completion.

strongest_changes: The adjacent seized eye and eye-like lunar sinking turn 75:7-8 into a coupled collapse of perceiver and perceived light.
The moon's immediate reappearance in 75:9 and the surah's repeated gathering operations revise disappearance into controlled deactivation before recomposition.
The sun-moon pair and the later leg-leg pair support an exploratory cosmic-body death sequence.
The closing power over life and death prevents deprivation of lunar function from requiring absolute annihilation.
summary.what_was_special: The whole-surah package exposed repeated operations across domains: standing against sinking, gathering body/cosmos/recitation, outward sight against inward witness, and paired luminaries against paired limbs. These patterns changed the focus from a single astronomical portent into several coexisting spatial, optical, procedural, embodied, and status-reversal mechanisms.
remaining_uncertainties: The conventional eclipse sense may dominate so strongly that the downward spatial force of the ground-sinking branch remains imagistic rather than semantic.
The macrocosm-body and face-radiance readings depend on reader-supplied cross-domain arrows rather than explicit identity statements.
Peripheral qamar branches in the outliers are controlled lexical resonances and should not be promoted to direct translations.
